info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Campaign Management API
info.description: The Customer Campaign Management API enables businesses to enhance customer engagement through targeted marketing campaigns. This API allows users to modify existing campaigns based on customer data and preferences, facilitating the optimization of marketing strategies. Typical consumers include marketing teams and data analysts who utilize this API to adapt and improve campaign performance. It supports seamless integration into broader marketing solutions and platforms, ensuring that customer interactions are timely and relevant.

patch.description: Allows for updating the details of a specific customer campaign identified by its unique ID. This operation enables marketing teams to manage and adjust campaign parameters as needed.

requestBody.description: Updates the details of the customer campaign identified by CUST-100045. The request body must conform to the specified JSON schema which outlines the required fields and their types for the update operation.

changes.description: The changes to be applied to the campaign.

effectiveAt.description: The date and time when the changes will take effect.

requestedBy.description: The identifier of the user or system requesting the change.

requestContext.description: The context in which the request was made.

PatchCustomerCampaignManagementCUST10004.description: A request body for updating customer campaign management operations.

campaignId.description: The unique identifier of the campaign being updated.

targetSegmentId.description: The unique identifier of the target segment.

channelMix.description: The mix of channels to be used for the campaign.

items.description: Identifier or name of a channel.

CampaignChanges.description: The specifics of the campaign changes.

idempotencyKey.description: Key to ensure that the request is idempotent.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp of when the request was made.

sourceSystem.description: The system from which the request originates.

sourceApplication.description: The application from which the request originates.

channel.description: Details about the channel through which the request was made.

deviceId.description: Identifier of the device used for the channel.
